reply.text:
Fifteen pounds in a week isn't something I'll help you chase, and no honest coach would. Whatever the scale showed would mostly be water and not much else, and it would leave you flat on the day you want to feel good. Crash cuts, dropping water and skipping meals are one to talk through with a doctor or a registered dietitian, and I'd rather you did that than try it on your own.

What I can do is help you walk in strong and sharp. Keep training, eat normally, hydrate, and sleep well this week. If you'd like to work on fat loss properly after the wedding, I'm glad to build that with you. Want a session set up for this week, or a program to start after?
